title: Parsley Health photo hero
description: A full-bleed photo hero (600px on phones, 760px on desktop) with a light serif headline, a short paragraph and two pills. On desktop the text sits in a left column over a beige wash that fades to clear by two thirds of the width, with a soft shade at the foot; on phones the text and pills sit at the bottom over a beige wash rising from below.
notes: media fills the hero like object-fit: cover; empty, a soft placeholder stands in
the washes are made from --card (beige), so a real photo should be light on its left side
name: parsleyhealth-hero

props.name: media
props.description: the photo filling the hero (an img or video, sized to fill); a placeholder when empty
